description: Neutral, accessible light theme for email and print.
name: report-light

provenance.diverging: palette ends with --ink at 20 % as the neutral midpoint
provenance.fonts: The source UIs' web fonts are not bundled; DejaVu Sans ships with matplotlib, so a render is byte-identical on every machine.
provenance.muted: --ink at 70 % on --paper (site --text-dim-ink, ink at 55 %, is 4.4:1: below 4.5:1 for text)
palette: admin --indigo hue at OKLCH lightness 0.40 (dark enough to stay apart from the purple under protan/deutan simulation)
admin --cyan hue darkened to 4.5:1 on white
provenance.roles: forecast lines at 85 % opacity: at the renderer's default 75 % the purple series colour is 2.92:1 on white, below 3:1 for graphics
provenance.semantic: admin --green / --red hues darkened to 4.5:1, signal as attention
provenance.sequential: matplotlib viridis sampled on [0, 0.82] (high end visible on white)
provenance.signal: admin --orange hue darkened to 3:1 on white; reserved
provenance.source: a light site design-token set (CSS custom properties) and a dark dashboard design-token set (CSS custom properties)

email.description: 1200 x 750 px; shown about 600 px wide in mail
